messages:
mike: Heads up — planning to unpin runtime v3.2.1 from canary tonight at 23:00 UTC. This is the kv-cache performance fix rolling out. Need SDK compatibility sanity and release-note check before we flip. @anna?

anna: Ack. I updated the release notes draft with a short blurb about KV cache behavior changes and fallback semantics. Link: https://go/release/notes/3.2.1-draft

kevin: Quick compat note: SDK 1.8.0 has the new header glue but older SDKs (<=1.7.x) will still talk to 3.2.1, just won't surface the new streaming opt. We should gate canary for 1.8+ routes only.

mike: Good call. We'll limit traffic to SDK 1.8+ in canary. Deploybot — preflight when ready?

deploy-bot: preflight-run triggered by @mike for runtime v3.2.1 -> unpin CANARY scope
deploy-bot: checks: config-sync ✓, infra-health ✓, model-compat matrix ✓, sdk-compatibility: WARN (routes 1.7.x present)
deploy-bot: hint: 12 routes matched with SDK <1.8 — recommend reroute or exclude from canary

anna: I'll add a canary route filter to the release config to exclude SDK <1.8. Also pinging support to block accidental keys if needed.

sara: QA: can we schedule a quick e2e on staging with longseq + embeddings? Want to validate latency regression under 95th pct. I can run a 30m probe starting 21:30 UTC.

mike: Please do. QA probe success criteria: error-rate <0.5% and 95th latency delta <30% vs baseline. If either fails, abort unpin.

kevin: Also adding telemetry gating: shipper will watch token-per-request CPU and kvcache hit ratio. If kvcache hit ratio drops >15% for 5m, that's a hard stop.

deploy-bot: telemetry watch registered: metrics -> [error_rate, p95_latency, kvcache_hit_ratio, token_cpu]. Alerts configured to post to #eng-oncall + this thread.

mike: Ops: brief rollback plan — if we trigger stop criteria we'll pin back to runtime v3.1.8 automatically and open rollback runbook. Manual confirmation required to unpin again.

anna: Release notes finalized and synced to the docs repo. QA checklist in the doc.

sara: Staging probe started at 21:30 UTC. Running longseq 8k tokens + embedding workload. Will post results in 30m.

deploy-bot: staging-preflight result: PASS (sdk filter applied), staging-probe: running

sara: Staging probe complete. Results: error-rate 0.12%, p95 latency +18%, kvcache hit ratio -4%. All within thresholds. Uploaded logs: https://go/logs/3990012345-staging-probe

mike: Nice. Given QA green and no older SDK routes in canary, plan stands for 23:00 UTC unpin. I'll kick it off and monitor.

kevin: Reminder: mention in release notes that behavior changes only affect cold-kv-cache scenarios and there's an opt-out env for extremely latency-sensitive customers.

mike: Good note. Added that bullet. Unpinning at 23:00 UTC now. Will update here when deploybot reports.

deploy-bot: unpin job started for CANARY scope at 23:00 UTC
deploy-bot: rollout step 1/4: config applied to canary routing ✓
deploy-bot: rollout step 2/4: runtime fleet draining and restart ✓
deploy-bot: rollout step 3/4: traffic switch to runtime v3.2.1 for canary routes ✓
deploy-bot: telemetry warmup in progress (5m)

deploy-bot: telemetry snapshot after warmup: error_rate 0.09% (baseline 0.08%), p95_latency +20% (within 30%), kvcache_hit_ratio -5%

mike: Monitoring. No rollback triggers. Leaving canary running for 90m before staged ramp.

kevin: I'll push a note to the SDK changelog to remind teams about the streaming opt and route filtering.

anna: Posting a short blurb in #announcements for partner-facing customers with opt-out link.

sara: I'll run a quick additional probe with embeddings-heavy traffic at 23:45 UTC to confirm steady state.

deploy-bot: background probe result (23:45 UTC): error_rate 0.11%, p95 +22%, kvcache_hit_ratio -6% — stable.

mike: All good. Marking canary unpin complete. Preparing staged ramp plan for tomorrow 02:00 UTC (25% traffic), will open separate thread for ramp.

kevin: One follow-up: add a temporary telemetry gate to auto-annotate evals if p95 drift >20% during next 24h. Helps correlate quality regressions.

mike: Agreed. Kevin, can you create the gate?

kevin: On it, will post config in #eng-infra in 10m.

deploy-bot: note: if rollback occurs, runbook link -> https://go/runbooks/rollback-runtime-3x
